definition: Official statistics are figures produced or designated by public authorities under established standards for public use.
entry_text: Official statistics are figures produced or designated by public authorities under established standards for public use.
example: A statistics agency publishes a monthly unemployment rate based on a household survey.
label: Official statistics

sources.note: UN General Assembly principles 1, 2, and 9 cover official statistical agencies, public access, and professional and international statistical standards.
